qset.question: What is the annual OPD cover amount under the Even membership?
Does the Even OPD plan have a waiting period?
What is the co-pay amount for the Even OPD plan?
What is the deductible under the Even OPD plan?
What type of claims process does the Even OPD plan use?
How can a member contact Even if they have questions?
What does the managed care benefit include according to the document?
qset.answer: Even doctors create your unique health profile and design specialised programs to manage your health risks and wellness goals with in-house specialists

qset.question: What happens during physiotherapy if satisfactory ADL is achieved after five sessions?
qset.answer: Physiotherapy will stop if satisfactory ADL is achieved after the condition is reviewed following five sessions

qset.question: Which dental services are excluded, and what is the only dental diagnostic exception?
qset.answer: Diagnostics or treatment related to teeth or structures supporting teeth are not covered; dental X-rays are the exception

qset.question: What is the first step a member should follow to use Even for consultations or lab tests?
qset.answer: Book a quick video consultation with our in-house doctors on the Even app, by calling our support number or texting your Even Care team
